verifications.claim: Rocky Carroll is leaving NCIS as a series regular after 18 seasons.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Carroll is leaving NCIS after 18 seasons'; R2: 'Rocky Carroll's Leon Vance is permanently retired... 18 years'; R3: '18 seasons'; similar in all sources.
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly confirm Carroll's departure as series regular/actor after 18 seasons.

verifications.claim: Director Leon Vance is killed off in NCIS's 500th episode (Season 23, 2026).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NCIS Episode 500 (Season 23 Episode 13)'; R4: 'March 24 500th episode... Season 23'; all confirm Vance killed in 500th ep, S23, 2026 context.
verifications.reasoning: All sources directly state Vance's death in the 500th episode of Season 23, aired 2026.

verifications.claim: Rocky Carroll will remain with NCIS as a director, notes Variety.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3 (Variety): 'Carroll is a frequent director on the show, and already has returned to the set... I also direct three, sometimes four episodes every season. And I think that will continue.'
verifications.reasoning: Variety explicitly states Carroll will continue directing on NCIS.

verifications.claim: Rocky Carroll has directed multiple episodes in previous seasons of NCIS, notes Variety.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3 (Variety): 'Carroll is a frequent director on the show'; 'I also direct three, sometimes four episodes every season.'
verifications.reasoning: Variety confirms Carroll has directed multiple episodes over previous seasons.

verifications.claim: The death of Director Vance was an intentional decision to "shake up" the 500th episode, notes Parade.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R8 (Parade): 'How do you think this will shake up the show?... I think it's going to shake things up quite a bit.'; producers: '500th episode, we’ve got to do something... make a huge splash'; R5 similar.
verifications.reasoning: Parade quotes Carroll on shaking up the show post-death; context confirms producers' intentional bold choice for 500th.

verifications.claim: Rocky Carroll will return to the set shortly to direct future episodes of NCIS Season 23, as reported by Marca.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6 (Marca): 'He remains actively involved behind the camera and has already returned to direct new episodes of the series.'
verifications.reasoning: Marca reports Carroll already returned shortly after to direct new episodes; context is S23.

verifications.claim: Rocky Carroll called it a "See you later" rather than a final goodbye, as reported by Marca.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R6 (Marca): 'Not a full goodbye... the door isn't entirely closed.' (no 'See you later' quote)
verifications.reasoning: Marca reports similar sentiment but not the specific 'See you later' quote (found in R2, not Marca).

verifications.claim: Leon Vance joined NCIS in Season 5.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'having debuted in Season 5 Episode 14'; R2: 'since the end of Season 5'; consistent across sources.
verifications.reasoning: All references confirm Vance joined in Season 5.

verifications.claim: Leon Vance became the longest-running director in NCIS's history.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'the running joke is, “You are the longest tenured director in history.”'; R5/R8 (Parade): 'he’s been the longest-running director... longest tenured director in history, either real or make-believe.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources, including Parade and Variety, explicitly state Vance as longest-running director.
